items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But they weren’t into Bessie Smith and that kind of thing, blues? [INTERVIEWEE] No. My father never was much of a blues person.

ctx.x: At that time they really weren’t recording church music, that music. That really started when they started gospel music. See, because actually the recordings that were made then – there wasn’t but a handful of people recording at that time, to my knowledge.
But they weren’t into Bessie Smith and that kind of thing, blues?
No. My father never was much of a blues person.
